en.title: Mozart: Eine kleine Nachtmusik, K. 525 – I. Allegro
en.overview: This movement is for string quartet: two violins, viola and cello. It is in G major and has two big parts, each marked as repeated. Part 1 is [m. 1-55] and Part 2 is [m. 56-137]. Listen for the opening tune, which comes back in Part 2. Keys and chords here are estimated by computer, so small details may be off. The facts give no loud or soft markings, so this guide does not describe dynamics.

listening_points.headline: The opening tune, all four together
listening_points.text: The main theme starts in the first violin at [m. 1]. The second violin plays it at the same pitch. The viola and cello play it lower. From [m. 2-4] the parts play in unison or octaves, which means the same notes at the same time.

listening_points.headline: The tune settles into melody and accompaniment
listening_points.text: Now the first violin clearly has the tune, and the others accompany it [m. 5-8]. The analysis is very confident about this lead. At [m. 9] the lines become more independent.

listening_points.headline: Staying in G major, with chordal moments
listening_points.text: The music stays in the home key of G major. Several bars have the instruments moving together in chords, such as [m. 13-15]. The first violin probably leads most of this stretch.

listening_points.headline: A first move to D major
listening_points.text: The key shifts to D major at [m. 22]. At [m. 24-25] the instruments move together in chords. The analysis cannot say who leads there, so treat it as shared.

listening_points.headline: Brief visit to A major
listening_points.text: At [m. 27] the key moves to A major. The texture changes often here between chords, a lead voice, and independent lines. Who leads is unclear. At [m. 36] the two violins share it.

listening_points.headline: Back to D major to close Part 1
listening_points.text: D major returns at [m. 39] and lasts to the end of Part 1. Near the end, the instruments move in chords [m. 49-53]. The analysis marks [m. 51] as the loudest or busiest point. This is a computer estimate, and the score has no marking for it.

listening_points.headline: Part 2 begins with the opening tune
listening_points.text: Part 2 starts at [m. 56] with the main theme again. It is now lower, in D major. All four parts play it. At [m. 57-59] they play in unison or octaves, as at the opening.

listening_points.headline: Key changes: G major, then C major
listening_points.text: At [m. 60] the key becomes G major. The first violin has the tune over an accompaniment. At [m. 64] the key shifts to C major.

listening_points.headline: A darker turn to G minor
listening_points.text: At [m. 67] the key becomes G minor. A minor key usually sounds darker than the major keys around it. Listen for the change of colour.

listening_points.headline: Passing through D major and back home
listening_points.text: A short stop in D major comes at [m. 72-73]. Then G major returns at [m. 74].

listening_points.headline: The opening tune returns in G major
listening_points.text: At [m. 76] the main theme comes back at the original pitch in the first violin. The viola and cello play it too, lower. They play in unison or octaves, as at the start. This is the moment to listen for.

listening_points.headline: Familiar material again
listening_points.text: The first violin leads, with accompaniment, from [m. 80] on. The estimated chords here match those of [m. 5-21], so the music should feel familiar.

listening_points.headline: D major once more
listening_points.text: The key goes to D major at [m. 97]. The first violin probably leads. The second violin probably takes over briefly at [m. 105]. Lead confidence is lower here.

listening_points.headline: Back in G major
listening_points.text: At [m. 112] the music returns to G major. It stays there to the end. Chords dominate [m. 122-126].

listening_points.headline: The final bars in G major
listening_points.text: The first violin leads over an accompaniment through [m. 127-135]. The movement ends at [m. 137] with the instruments moving together in chords.

glossary.explanation: A main tune that you can recognise when it comes back.
The home note and scale that the music centres on. Changing key changes the colour of the music.
A move from one key to another.
Instruments playing the same tune at the same time, at the same or different heights.
One part has the tune while the others support it.
The parts move together, mostly in chords.
Each part follows its own path at the same time.
A key that usually sounds darker or sadder than a major key.

zh.title: 莫扎特《弦乐小夜曲》K. 525 第一乐章 快板 聆听指南
zh.overview: 这是一个为两把小提琴、中提琴和大提琴写的乐章，主调是 G 大调，4/4 拍。乐章分两大部分：第一部分（第 1-55 小节）和第二部分（第 56-137 小节），每部分都标有反复。请留意开头的主题，它会在不同的音高上回来。也请听第一小提琴如何带着旋律，以及调性怎样离开又回到 G 大调。本指南中的调和和弦都是电脑估算的。谱面没有力度记号，所以这里不谈强弱。

listening_points.headline: 主题登场，四件乐器一起开口
listening_points.text: 乐章从 G 大调开始。第一小提琴带出主题 [m. 1-2]。第二小提琴、中提琴和大提琴也在奏同一个主题，只是音区不同。随后 [m. 2-4] 各声部以齐奏或八度进行，也就是同一条旋律在不同高低上一起走。

listening_points.headline: 第一小提琴唱旋律，其他声部伴奏
listening_points.text: [m. 5-8] 第一小提琴明显领头。其余三件乐器在下面伴奏。织体变成“旋律加伴奏”，也就是一个声部唱，其他声部托着。这一段仍在 G 大调。

listening_points.headline: 在 G 大调里来回走动
listening_points.text: [m. 9-21] 音乐留在 G 大调。织体在几种形式间切换。[m. 9] 各声部走各自的线条。[m. 13-15] 声部节奏相近，一起前进。[m. 16-23] 又回到旋律加伴奏。第一小提琴大部分时间仍是主角。

listening_points.headline: 转到 D 大调，中低声部可能短暂靠前
listening_points.text: [m. 22] 音乐转到 D 大调。[m. 24-25] 中提琴和大提琴可能占了主导，但这个判断很不确定，更像是大家共同发声。这两小节是主调织体，也就是各声部节奏相近、像和弦一样一起走。

listening_points.headline: A 大调：织体变化频繁
listening_points.text: [m. 27] 调性转到 A 大调，一直持续到 [m. 38]。这一段织体变化很频繁。[m. 31]、[m. 34]、[m. 36]、[m. 38] 各声部的线条较独立，中间夹着旋律加伴奏。领奏者不太固定，第二小提琴在 [m. 32] 可能短暂领头。

listening_points.headline: 回到 D 大调，走向第一部分的高点
listening_points.text: [m. 39] 调性回到 D 大调，并停留到第一部分结束。[m. 41-42] 和 [m. 49-53] 是几个声部一起走的主调织体。分析估计整个乐章最响、最忙的点在 [m. 51]。这只是电脑的估计，谱上没有力度记号。

listening_points.headline: 第一部分结束，进入第二部分
listening_points.text: 第一部分到 [m. 55] 结束，按标记要反复一次。[m. 56] 第二部分开始，仍在 D 大调。第二部分也有反复。

listening_points.headline: 主题以 D 大调回来
listening_points.text: [m. 56-57] 开头的主题在 D 大调再次出现，四个声部都有。它比开头低了 5 个半音，所以是同一句话，但音高不同。[m. 57-59] 是齐奏或八度进行。

listening_points.headline: G 大调到 C 大调，两种织体交替
listening_points.text: [m. 60] 音乐转回 G 大调，[m. 64] 又去 C 大调。这里旋律加伴奏和独立声部线条一小节一小节地交替。第一小提琴领头的把握较高。

listening_points.headline: 转入 G 小调，色彩变暗
listening_points.text: [m. 67-71] 转入 G 小调，听起来会比大调暗一些，请留意这种色彩变化。[m. 69-70] 是主调织体，[m. 71] 是齐奏或八度进行。[m. 72-73] 短暂到 D 大调。

listening_points.headline: 回到 G 大调，开头主题重现
listening_points.text: [m. 74] 回到 G 大调。[m. 76-77] 开头主题以和一开始相同的音高回来，由第一小提琴、中提琴和大提琴奏出。[m. 76-79] 是齐奏或八度进行。

listening_points.headline: 熟悉的段落再现
listening_points.text: [m. 80-83] 第一小提琴再次领旋律，其余伴奏，织体与 [m. 5-8] 相同。后面 [m. 84-96] 的织体走向也和 [m. 9-21] 对应。如果你记得第一部分开头，会有似曾相识的感觉。

listening_points.headline: D 大调再现，织体来回切换
listening_points.text: [m. 97] 音乐去到 D 大调，一直保持到 [m. 111]。[m. 99-108] 以旋律加伴奏为主，领奏者不太明确。[m. 109-111] 又出现独立声部线条。

listening_points.headline: G 大调收尾，第一小提琴带到终点
listening_points.text: [m. 112] 回到 G 大调，直到乐章结束。[m. 122-126] 是几个声部一起走的主调织体。[m. 132-135] 第一小提琴明确领旋律，其余伴奏。最后 [m. 137] 是主调织体。

glossary.explanation: 调是音乐的“中心音”和整体色彩。转调就是中心换了，听起来像换了一种明暗。
大调一般听起来较明亮，小调一般较暗。
乐章里最重要、最容易记住的旋律。本乐章的主题在开头出现，后面会回来。
几个声部节奏相近，像一串和弦一起前进。
一个声部唱旋律，其他声部在下面托着。
各声部走各自的线条，不是简单跟随。
几件乐器奏同一条旋律，只是高低八度不同。
一个部分奏完后再从头奏一遍。
